advice.text: Both axles lock under hard braking: brake pressure too high overall — bring it down to the knee.
advice.evidence: median deficit F 0.69 / R 0.67; 3/4 stops locked both

advice.text: Launch wheelspin on the rears: accel diff lock down / taller 1st, or squeeze the throttle.
advice.evidence: median peak rear slip 6.91; 3/3 launches spun

advice.text: AWD fronts spinning at launch: center split more rearward / front accel diff down.
Fronts run 15 F+ hotter than rears: the understeer thermal signature — check pressures/camber on the HUD (Tires Misc + Heat).
advice.evidence: median F 110 F vs R 78 F

advice.text: Balance varies corner to corner (USI spread 0.22) — likely speed-dependent (mechanical vs aero). Split the verdict by corner speed before tuning.
